title: WriteFreely update_post has redundant auth check
description: writefreely_api.rs update_post (line 96-161) checks the edit token twice. Lines 108-113 check token_ok and, if false, fall through to owner auth. Then lines 124-133 check the token AGAIN, this time returning 401 on mismatch. If the first check already authenticated via owner auth (lines 115-123), the second token check can incorrectly reject an owner who provided an invalid token alongside valid bearer auth. The same pattern appears in delete_post (lines 185-210). The intent appears to be: accept either a valid token OR valid owner auth, but the double check means providing a bad token blocks even authenticated owners.
